surface_label: Army selects Austin for Futures Command; Austin Chamber and Capital Factory pitched Central Texas, 12 July 2018
bounded_by: KUT
notes: KUT reports the Army chose Austin for Army Futures Command and that "The Austin Chamber of Commerce and Capital Factory were involved in pitching Central Texas for the facility"; Governor Abbott is quoted. The article does not say what the pitch offered.

surface_label: Army Futures Command HQ news conference at the Greater Austin Chamber, 13 July 2018 (Stars and Stripes)
bounded_by: Stars and Stripes
notes: Stars and Stripes (16 July 2018) describes a Friday (13 July 2018) news conference at the Greater Austin Chamber of Commerce with Governor Greg Abbott, chamber SVP Charisse Bodisch and Lt. Gen. Eric Wesley; it names Capital Factory as one potential location for a Futures Command team and quotes "Josh Baer, founder and CEO of Capital Factory" ("This is a big deal"). Baer is quoted in the article, not placed at the news conference, so his row carries the publication date.

surface_label: Army Futures Command activation ceremony in Austin, 24 August 2018 (Army photo caption)
bounded_by: Army News Service photo caption (article of 22 July 2019)
notes: An Army News Service photo caption (article by Sean Kimmons, 22 July 2019) records Command Sgt. Maj. Michael Crosby participating in the command's activation ceremony in Austin on 24 August 2018 along with Gen. Mark Milley; the caption is truncated before the remaining names. The same article says the Army Applications Laboratory "has set up shop inside Capital Factory".

surface_label: Army Futures Command ribbon cutting and Capital Factory co-location as reported, 24 August 2018
bounded_by: CNBC
Defense One
notes: CNBC reports Army Secretary Mark Esper spoke at the ribbon cutting and that the command "shares" space with Capital Factory; it quotes Under Secretary Ryan McCarthy. Defense One (27 August 2018) reports the command "will also have a big physical presence at Capital Factory" and quotes McCarthy and Gen. Mark Milley. Neither shows lease terms or payments.

surface_label: Gen. John Murray visits innovators at Capital Factory, 30 September 2018 (Army photo caption)
bounded_by: Army News Service photo caption (article of 11 July 2019)
notes: Army photo caption: Gen. John Murray, commander of Army Futures Command, listens to innovators during a visit to Capital Factory on 30 September 2018; "The command's Army Applications Laboratory now operates out of the startup hub".

surface_label: Army News Service: AFC HQ in the Capital Factory building, DIU and AFWERX on its fifth floor, AAL and SOFWERX hackathon, 22 October 2018
bounded_by: Army News Service article by David Vergun
notes: Army News Service (David Vergun, 22 October 2018), reporting Gen. John M. Murray: other organizations "have quietly set up shop in offices on the fifth floor of the Capital Factory building, where AFC HQ is located", including DIU and AFWERX; AFC's Army Applications Laboratory and SOCOM's SOFWERX sponsored a hackathon; Capital Factory and other hubs "will work with promising startups". This is the Army's own statement that its command headquarters sat in the Capital Factory building; it does not give lease or payment terms.

surface_label: Capital Factory Center for Defense Innovation opens with AFC, AFWERX and DIU as tenants, 2019 (company timeline)
bounded_by: Capital Factory About and Government pages
notes: Year-only date (2019) from the company's own timeline; recorded as 2019-01-01, month and day not established. Capital Factory says 23,000 sq ft of public-private collaboration space opened "with Army Futures Command, AFWERX, and DIU as tenants", later renamed the Center for Dual-Use Innovation; its Government page says AFC "establishes its headquarters in Austin" and AFWERX and DIU "come to Capital Factory" in 2018, the Center opens in 2019, Fed Supernova begins in 2020 and the Center is rebranded in 2024 when "a joint DoW innovation space opens on the 8th floor of the Austin Centre". Tenancy is the company's claim; official records above corroborate the AFC, AAL, DIU and AFWERX presence for 2018-2019.
